modern: Remember that to change your opinion and to follow someone who corrects your error is as consistent with freedom as it is to persist in your error. For it is your own—the activity which is carried out according to your own impulse and judgement, and indeed according to your own understanding too.
original: Remember that to change thy opinion and to follow him who corrects thy error is as consistent with freedom as it is to persist in thy error. For it is thy own, the activity which is exerted according to thy own movement and judgment, and indeed according to thy own understanding too.
